**Estimating Effort Now**

I'm currently focused on breaking down these user stories into estimable tasks within the Spring Cloud Dataflow and Stream ecosystem. My aim is to provide a clear work-hour estimation for each component.

**Implementing Features Now**

My current focus is on integrating the HDFS Sink module and exploring repository options for composed jobs. I'm also investigating how to orchestrate these composed jobs and enhance testing for shell commands.

**Developing S-C-S Components Now**

I'm currently working on integrating the HDFS sink module and exploring repository options for composed jobs, alongside orchestrating and testing shell commands. My immediate next steps involve refactoring the JDBC sink and Kafka source modules for Spring Cloud Stream.

**Estimating Remaining Effort**

I'm now detailing estimations for the remaining user stories, ranging from Hadoop commands to isolated shell testing and expression-based bindings. I've also solidified the core technical stack, targeting Spring Framework 6.x on Java 17+ with a modular architecture.

technical_and_design_decisions: Target Java 17+ and modern Spring Boot / Spring Cloud Data Flow and Spring Cloud Stream architectural patterns.
Utilize Spring Shell framework for implementing modular Hadoop CLI commands in the interactive shell.
Implement HDFS Sink as a Spring Cloud Stream application using standard Apache Hadoop Client libraries.
Design Composed Job Repository using relational metadata tables managed via Spring Data JPA / Spring Batch metadata standards.
Implement Composed Job Orchestration via a dedicated Task Launcher component parsing job DAG/workflow DSLs.
Use Spring Expression Language (SpEL) for dynamic message header and property evaluation in Spring Cloud Stream bindings.
Migrate legacy Spring XD modules (JDBC Sink and Kafka Source) to standalone Spring Cloud Stream standalone application starters.
assumptions: A local or containerized Hadoop/HDFS environment is available for integration testing.
Development work will be performed by a single developer with experience in Spring Boot, Spring Cloud Stream, and Spring Cloud Data Flow.
Non-functional infrastructure (CI/CD pipelines, repository hosting) is already established.

activities.activity_description: Initial setup of multi-module build configuration, dependency management, and analysis of legacy Spring XD components to be migrated.

activities.activity_name: U1: HDFS Sink Module Implementation & Registry Integration
activities.activity_description: Develop the HDFS sink Spring Cloud Stream application, supporting file writing, rolling policies, configuration options, and module registration.

activities.activity_name: U2: Hadoop Commands Support in Shell
activities.activity_description: Implement Spring Shell commands for standard HDFS operations (ls, cat, copy, rm, mkdir) communicating with Hadoop FileSystem APIs.

activities.activity_name: U3: Composed Jobs Repository Options Spike & Design
activities.activity_description: Investigate and prototype storage options (RDBMS vs Key-Value) for persisting composed job definitions, DSL representations, and execution states.
Develop the execution graph parser and orchestrator to trigger sequential/parallel task launches for composed workflows.

activities.activity_name: U5: Isolated Shell Command Testing Framework
activities.activity_description: Create a mock-based test harness for testing Spring Shell commands in isolation without spawning full end-to-end stream runtime environments.

activities.activity_name: U6: Expression-Based Message Property Binding Engine
activities.activity_description: Implement SpEL evaluation support in Spring Cloud Stream bindings to extract and map dynamic payload/header attributes to module properties.

activities.activity_name: U7: JDBC Sink Module Migration from Spring XD
activities.activity_description: Refactor legacy Spring XD JDBC sink into a modern Spring Cloud Stream application with auto-configuration and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: U8: Kafka Source Module Migration from Spring XD
activities.activity_description: Port legacy Spring XD Kafka source into a Spring Cloud Stream application utilizing modern Spring for Apache Kafka binder capabilities.
Perform overall integration testing across shell commands, modules, and orchestration engine; write user documentation and deployment guides.
